pulls.title: Open pull requests
pulls.notCollectedHint: Run portta repos scan --with-prs on the host with gh installed and signed in, or configure the GitHub App.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The files an agent reads before it works, as the host scan found them.
instructions.emptyHint: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, CONVENTIONS.md, .cursor/rules/*.mdc and the like are collected when they exist at the repository root.
instructions.overBound: This file is {{size}}, over the collection bound
instructions.overBoundHint: Only files up to 64 KiB are collected in full. Open it on the host.

detail.title: Repository
detail.noPath: not registered with a directory; the scan matched it by its remote

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Compose projects running from this repository, per the host scan.
environments.empty: Nothing is running from this repository

commits.title: Recent commits
commits.description: The last twenty, as metadata. A diff is a link to the forge.
commits.stale: The list is older than the collector's threshold.

page.notScanned: This repository has not been scanned yet
page.notScannedHint: The watcher scans once a minute. To do it now:
page.removeDescription: Only the registration goes. Nothing on disk, on GitHub or in any environment is touched.

add.title: Add a repository to {{name}}
add.description: A repository is a decision: name it here and the host scan fills in the Git facts.

discovered.empty: Every scanned repository is already registered
discovered.emptyHint: The scan lists git roots under Projects Home and under running environments. Run portta repos scan on the host, or add one by hand.
discovered.unavailable: The scan index could not be read

github.description: Only repositories the GitHub App installation granted can be linked.
github.hint: Configure the GitHub App under Settings → GitHub and press Sync. A project works without it; it just has no GitHub repositories.
github.noneGranted: No repository has been granted yet
github.noneGrantedHint: Install the GitHub App on the repositories this project owns, then press Sync under Settings → GitHub.

manual.name: Name
manual.localPathHint: Absolute. The scan reads it on the next pass.
